worldcombat.skill.doublekick.summary: A two-beat close attack: the first low kick pops the target off the ground and the second boot sends it away. Alternate style lifts then launches for control; straight style keeps both kicks low, faster and harder.
worldcombat.skill.doublekick.use.0: A one-two close kick that lifts then launches
worldcombat.skill.doublekick.use.1: Kick a foe pressed against you out of position
worldcombat.skill.doublekick.use.2: Punish a foe that stands its ground, beat after beat
worldcombat.skill.doublekick.description: First kick %1$s power, second kick %2$s power (speed/attack), lifting the target %3$s blocks, then knocking it %4$s blocks away.
Kick reach %1$s blocks, forward angle %2$s degrees, gap between kicks %3$s, about %4$s dust per kick.
worldcombat.skill.doublekick.alternate.o: Alternate style now: the first kick lifts the foe and the second launches it away, pulling it out of position; each kick is lighter and the beat slightly slower.
Straight style now: both kicks stay low and do not lift, each harder with a shorter gap, so the attack comes out faster.
worldcombat.skill.doublekick.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.doublekick.growth.0: From level %1$s the first kick rises to %2$s and the second to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.doublekick.growth.1: From level %1$s the first kick is %2$s and the second is %3$s.
On: the first kick lifts the foe off the ground and the second launches it away, pulling it out of position; each kick is x0.92 with +1 tick gap and recovery. Off (straight): both kicks stay low, x1.08 per kick and -1 tick gap, faster and harder.
Beyond this distance it will not open with double kick and closes in first.
